title: A boopis team file
description: One document for a whole team: `boopis team apply` makes it, `boopis team export` writes it. See docs/CLI.md. Unknown keys are mistakes.

role.description: What the bot is for (its description).

soul.description: A file with its instructions, inside the team file's folder. Read when the file is loaded. Not with soul_text.

soul_text.description: Its instructions, written here. Export writes this.

skills.description: Skills it must have: checked, and switched on when off.

max_turns.description: The most turns `boopis run --bot` lets one task take with this bot (the engine's goal budget, `goals.max_turns`, in the bot's own configuration).

toolsets.description: Every engine toolset the bot has on; every other toolset it lists is switched off, the same for its chats, kanban workers and room turns (ADR-0048). Applies from the bot's next new session.

project.description: The bot's project folder (`terminal.cwd`): its sessions start there and read the folder's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md. A folder that is not there is refused.

env.description: Plain values only; keys belong in Settings > Connectors.

id.description: The id a room that exists has; a new room gets g-<name>.

members.description: Frozen once the room is made.

purpose_file.description: A file inside the team file's folder. Not with purpose.

workdir.description: An absolute path, or one starting with ~/.

schedule.description: A cron expression, `every 2h`, or a delay.

prompt_file.description: A file inside the team file's folder. Not with prompt.

room.description: A room's name; the result is posted there. Not with deliver.

as.description: Who posts in that room (the job's bot by default). Only with room.

deliver.description: A delivery target as the engine writes it. Not with room.
